title: Game-over panel

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot illustrated hand-painted fantasy game UI art. Restrained antique brass/gold, weathered dark wood and root details, deep blue-teal recesses, moss green and warm cream highlights. Selective crisp readable edges and soft painted material shading, elegant low-ornament UI suited to small screens. No characters, text, letters, numbers, interface labels, mockup boards, screenshots, gridlines, watermarks or drop shadows. ONE isolated WIDE landscape game-over menu PANEL SKIN, complete centered object with at least8% clear alpha margin all around. Dark opaque blue-teal inset rectangle with gently rounded weathered wooden/brass rim, restrained root motifs at corners. A small dim unlit wooden lantern and two wilted leaves form a compact upper-center crest. The INSIDE of the panel must be a quiet almost-uniform dark teal readable text backing; leave generous empty title region below crest, empty body, and broad empty lower area for separately rendered Retry/Main Menu buttons. No lettering, buttons, lines, labels, placeholder text, progressbar, portrait or scenery. Frame+backgroundskin only, NOT a flattened full UI screenshot. No aggressive glow or huge ornamentalbranches. All outside the complete physical panel is truly transparent.
